units.source_text: “总之，只剩下了我一个人，除了依照母亲的嘱咐，依靠这位叔叔之外，没有别的办法。

en.t: In any case, I was left all alone, and aside from relying on this uncle as my mother had instructed, there was no other way.

units.source_text: 叔叔也把所有的事都承担了下来，无比周到地关照我的生活，

en.t: My uncle also took everything upon himself and looked after my life with the greatest care,

units.source_text: 而且还为我安排去我向往已久的东京上学之事。

en.t: and he even arranged for me to go to Tokyo, where I had long wanted to study.
